identity_attestation.sanitized_facts: Phase 3A design 2.2 clause 1, a documented CLI or API primitive returning the resolved provider and exact model for the actual session: not established. The probe is a process apart from the governed session. The result rests on clause 2, structured per-response metadata naming the provider and exact model actually used: met. Captures 04-07: model_response.response_model, provider, profile, endpoint_host, response_independence_domain and tls_verified_host. Captures 04-06 also satisfy the B3 init predicates and clean exit. Capture 07 compares actual response_model with MiniMax-M3.1-Flash to distinguish resolution from a retired-id echo; this condition is met. Configuration, requested intent, auth and banners are not passing identity evidence.

limitations: No governed session of the real binary ran because production start remains closed; PTY, process-group, termination and timing results are not established.
A provider that misreports its own model remains a limitation.
What the provider retains is the provider's.
